summary: Langfuse v4 SDK bug fix VERIFIED end-to-end. GET /api/langfuse/status returns {enabled:true, auth_ok:true, last_error:null, host=us.cloud.langfuse.com, public_key_prefix=pk-lf-15b0, traces_sent monotonically increasing, last_flush_ts=fresh}. Sent 5 real chats across billing/refunds/technical/general intents through the public preview URL; traces_sent counter incremented on every single POST /api/chat (0->1->2->...->20 observed across runs) and last_error stayed null the entire time, confirming that v4 renames (start_as_current_observation(as_type='span'), obs.set_trace_io, obs.update) are correctly applied and no exceptions are being silently swallowed. Core /api/chat schema {agent,intent,confidence,response,trace_events,tool_calls} unchanged; refund query still routes to agent=refunds with check_refund_eligibility tool_call; billing/technical routing works. Full pytest suite 21/21 PASS in 48s (tests/backend_test.py 16 + tests/test_langfuse.py 5).

verification_details.traces_increment_evidence: Observed traces_sent go 0 -> 1 after single chat, then strictly increased (+1 per chat) across 4 additional chats in test_multiple_chats_increment_each_time. Cumulative counter at end of suite = 20. last_flush_ts monotonic non-decreasing.
verification_details.chat_schema_intact: POST /api/chat 'Please refund INV-1001, I cancelled last week.' -> agent=refunds, intent=refunds, tool_calls contains check_refund_eligibility, trace_events populated, real Emergent LLM (gpt-5.4-mini) latencies recorded. Langfuse instrumentation did NOT break the response.
verification_details.error_surfacing: last_error remains null after every chat, proving the try/except in run_turn is not catching any v3->v4 API mismatch. If the old start_as_current_span/update_trace calls were still in place, last_error would be populated on the first chat (it isn't).

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: LANGFUSE_STATUS[last_error] is only cleared on a successful flush. If a chat succeeds but flush raises transiently, subsequent successful chats will not re-clear it until another successful flush - acceptable but could mask stale errors briefly.

Minor: `_init_langfuse` calls `LANGFUSE_STATUS.setdefault('last_error', ...)` for the auth_check-failed branch, which is a no-op if 'last_error' was already set to None (default). Because 'last_error' key is pre-initialized to None in LANGFUSE_STATUS at module load, setdefault will NOT overwrite None with the auth-fail message. Consider using a direct assignment (`LANGFUSE_STATUS['last_error'] = ...` guarded by `if not LANGFUSE_STATUS.get('last_error')`) to guarantee the message is surfaced when auth_ok is False.
test_credentials: N/A - no auth flow. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY (universal) and LANGFUSE_* (user_provided_key, host=us.cloud.langfuse.com, pk-lf-15b0...) in /app/backend/.env are valid and verified live.
seed_data_creation: Test sessions prefixed with TEST_lf_* created and torn down by fixture. Used in-memory mock invoice INV-1001/INV-1002 for tool_call verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Langfuse v4 SDK integration is fully working. The GET /api/langfuse/status endpoint is the canonical diagnostic - if a user reports 'no traces in Langfuse UI', first hit that endpoint: if auth_ok=false the keys/host mismatch (their pk was made in EU cloud vs us.cloud); if traces_sent stays 0 after chats, the try/except in run_turn is swallowing something (check last_error). Current state: enabled=true, auth_ok=true, last_error=null, counter incrementing. If retesting after changes, run: `cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest tests/test_langfuse.py -v`.
rca of the issue: Root cause of the original 'no traces visible in Langfuse' bug: the code in agents.run_turn was calling Langfuse v3 SDK methods (`start_as_current_span`, `span.update_trace`) but the installed SDK is v4. In v4 these were renamed to `start_as_current_observation(as_type='span')` and split into `obs.update()` + `obs.set_trace_io()`. Because run_turn wraps the entire tracing block in a bare try/except that only logged at .warning level and (previously) did not surface the error, every chat silently threw AttributeError, aborted the tracing block, and no trace was ever flushed to Langfuse's ingestion API - so the Langfuse UI stayed empty. Fix applied by main agent (already in code and verified): (1) renamed to v4 API - start_as_current_observation(as_type='span'), obs.update(output=..., metadata=...), obs.set_trace_io(input=..., output=...); (2) added auth_check() at boot with LANGFUSE_STATUS.auth_ok exposed via new GET /api/langfuse/status; (3) explicit _langfuse.flush() after every turn so traces show up immediately; (4) LANGFUSE_STATUS.last_error is now populated on any Langfuse exception (visible via /api/langfuse/status) instead of being silent. Verified end-to-end via /api/langfuse/status: traces_sent goes up by 1 per chat and last_error remains null.
